title_en: Farmland Occupation Tax Law of the People's Republic of China

articles.content_en: Article 1 This Law is formulated for the purpose of rationally utilizing land resources, strengthening land administration, and protecting cultivated land.

Article 2 Units and individuals that occupy cultivated land within the territory of the People's Republic of China to construct buildings or structures or to engage in non-agricultural construction shall be taxpayers of cultivated land occupation tax and shall pay cultivated land occupation tax in accordance with the provisions of this Law.
Those that occupy cultivated land to construct farmland water conservancy facilities shall not pay cultivated land occupation tax.
For the purposes of this Law, 'cultivated land' means land used for planting crops.

Article 3 Cultivated land occupation tax shall be levied on a one-time basis based on the actual area of cultivated land occupied by the taxpayer as the tax basis, and at the applicable tax amount as prescribed. The tax payable shall be the actual area of cultivated land occupied by the taxpayer (in square meters) multiplied by the applicable tax amount.

Article 5 In areas where the per capita cultivated land is less than 0.5 mu, the province, autonomous region, or municipality directly under the Central Government may, based on the local economic development, appropriately increase the applicable tax amount for cultivated land occupation tax, but the increased portion shall not exceed 50% of the applicable tax amount determined in accordance with paragraph 2 of Article 4 of this Law. The specific applicable tax amounts shall be determined in accordance with the procedures prescribed in paragraph 2 of Article 4 of this Law.
Article 6 Where basic farmland is occupied, the tax shall be levied at 150% of the local applicable tax amount determined in accordance with paragraph 2 of Article 4 or Article 5 of this Law.

Article 7 The occupation of cultivated land by military installations, schools, kindergartens, social welfare institutions, and medical institutions shall be exempt from cultivated land occupation tax.
The occupation of cultivated land for railway lines, highway lines, airport runways, aircraft parking aprons, ports, waterways, and water conservancy projects shall be subject to cultivated land occupation tax at a reduced rate of 2 yuan per square meter.
Where rural residents occupy cultivated land within the prescribed land use standards to build self-use residential houses, cultivated land occupation tax shall be levied at half of the local applicable tax amount; where rural residents relocate with approval and the area of cultivated land occupied for building new self-use residential houses does not exceed the area of the original homestead, such portion shall be exempt from cultivated land occupation tax.
The surviving family members of rural martyrs, surviving family members of military personnel who died in the line of duty, disabled military personnel, and rural residents who meet the conditions for rural minimum subsistence allowance shall be exempt from cultivated land occupation tax when building new self-use residential houses within the prescribed land use standards.
Where necessary for the development of the national economy and social development, the State Council may prescribe other circumstances for exemption or reduction of cultivated land occupation tax, which shall be filed with the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress for record.

Article 8 Where, after exemption or reduction of cultivated land occupation tax in accordance with the provisions of paragraphs 1 and 2 of Article 7 of this Law, the taxpayer changes the purpose of the originally occupied land and it no longer falls under the circumstances for exemption or reduction of cultivated land occupation tax, the taxpayer shall pay the supplementary cultivated land occupation tax at the local applicable tax amount.
Article 9 Cultivated land occupation tax shall be collected by the tax authorities.

Article 10 The time of occurrence of the obligation to pay cultivated land occupation tax shall be the day on which the taxpayer receives the written notice from the competent department of natural resources regarding the procedures for occupying cultivated land. The taxpayer shall declare and pay cultivated land occupation tax within 30 days from the date of occurrence of the tax obligation.
The competent department of natural resources shall issue the construction land approval certificate based on the cultivated land occupation tax payment certificate or tax exemption certificate and other relevant documents.

Article 11 Where a taxpayer temporarily occupies cultivated land due to construction project construction or geological survey, the taxpayer shall pay cultivated land occupation tax in accordance with the provisions of this Law. If the taxpayer, within one year from the date of expiration of the approved period of temporary occupation, reclaims the land in accordance with law and restores the planting conditions, the full amount of cultivated land occupation tax paid shall be refunded.

Article 12 Those that occupy garden land, forest land, grassland, farmland water use land, aquaculture water surfaces, fishery waters and shoals, and other agricultural land to construct buildings or structures or to engage in non-agricultural construction shall pay cultivated land occupation tax in accordance with the provisions of this Law.
Where agricultural land as prescribed in the preceding paragraph is occupied, the applicable tax amount may be appropriately lower than the applicable tax amount determined in accordance with paragraph 2 of Article 4 of this Law for the region, but the reduced portion shall not exceed 50%. The specific applicable tax amounts shall be proposed by the people's government of the province, autonomous region, or municipality directly under the Central Government, reported to the standing committee of the people's congress at the same level for determination, and filed with the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress and the State Council for record.
Where agricultural land as prescribed in paragraph 1 of this Article is occupied to construct production facilities directly serving agricultural production, no cultivated land occupation tax shall be paid.

Article 13 The tax authorities shall establish a mechanism for sharing information related to cultivated land occupation tax and a mechanism for work cooperation with relevant departments. The relevant departments of natural resources, agriculture and rural affairs, water resources, and others under the local people's governments at or above the county level shall periodically provide to the tax authorities information such as conversion of agricultural land and temporary land occupation, to assist the tax authorities in strengthening the collection and administration of cultivated land occupation tax.
Where the tax authorities discover that the taxpayer's tax declaration data or materials are abnormal or that the taxpayer has failed to declare tax within the prescribed time limit, they may request the relevant departments to conduct a review, and the relevant departments shall issue a review opinion to the tax authorities within 30 days from the date of receiving the review request from the tax authorities.

Article 14 The collection and administration of cultivated land occupation tax shall be implemented in accordance with the provisions of this Law and the Tax Collection and Administration Law of the People's Republic of China.

Article 15 Where taxpayers, tax authorities, or their staff violate the provisions of this Law, legal liability shall be pursued in accordance with the provisions of the Tax Collection and Administration Law of the People's Republic of China and relevant laws and regulations.

Article 16 This Law shall come into force as of September 1, 2019. The 'Interim Regulation on Cultivated Land Occupation Tax of the People's Republic of China' promulgated by the State Council on December 1, 2007 shall be abolished simultaneously.
